name: Samrat Fast Robot on: schedule: - cron: '*/5 * * * *' workflow_dispatch: jobs: run-engine: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v2 - uses: actions/setup-node@v2 with: node-version: '16' - run: npm install firebase-admin - name: Run Engine env: FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT }} run: node settle.js
